title: Shrimp and Nourishing Salad
description: A simple yet nutritious salad recipe featuring succulent shrimp and a blend of healthy ingredients.
instructions: 1. Rinse the shrimp under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
2. In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the shrimp and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, until pink and cooked through.
4. In a large bowl, combine the chopped lettuce, sliced cucumber, cherry tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion.
5. Add the cooked shrimp on top of the salad.
6. Drizzle with nourishing dressing (see below) and toss to combine.
